name: thesis-mcwm-attribution-v15
interpretation: Reuse the first five prespecified v13 IQL initializers and completed reference evaluations. No test-based seed selection. Extra target replay uses recorded actions and a fixed 0.5 weight; synthetic models use current-policy actions and normalized confidence, so these are not identical action distributions. Fit both model banks in forced-family arms, changing only the selected bank. Development diagnosis on already-used days, not a fresh held-out confirmation.
